chapter: Tex. Gov't Code ch. 2256, Subchapter A
note: The section inventory of the subchapter, independent of what the register happens to cover. Its purpose is to make the difference between 'checked and clean' and 'never looked at' structural rather than rhetorical. Sec. 2256.018 does not exist; the legislature skipped it.

review_status_values.in_scope: imposes an obligation a policy review can test; absence of a control is a coverage gap
review_status_values.definitional: defines terms or names the chapter; nothing to test
review_status_values.consumed_as_predicate: governs applicability and is consumed by the predicate library rather than by a control
review_status_values.not_policy_testable: imposes a duty on someone other than the investing entity, or a duty no policy document can evidence

sections.title: Subchapter Cumulative
sections.note: Governs how the subchapter interacts with other law. Its effect is that a policy stricter than the chapter is conforming, which the evaluator honours by never scoring restriction as deficiency.
